description: Fetch job postings from SmartRecruiters by company ID or search globally by keyword.

city.description: Filter by city name (e.g. 'London', 'New York'). Leave blank for all cities.
city.title: City filter

companyIds.description: One or more SmartRecruiters company identifiers (e.g. 'GOOG', 'Microsoft'). Required for mode=getJobs.
companyIds.title: Company IDs (mode=getJobs)

country.description: Filter by ISO 3166 2-letter country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de', 'fr'). Leave blank for all countries.
country.title: Country filter

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job postings to return (1–10000).
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: Choose how to fetch jobs. 'getJobs' fetches all postings for specific companies; 'searchJobs' searches globally across all SmartRecruiters companies.
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Keyword query for global job search (e.g. 'software engineer', 'product manager').
query.title: Search query (mode=searchJobs)

title: SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper Input
